embeddedReportPolicy: The complete independent initial report is preserved without rewriting findings, scores, provenance or limitations. No reconciliation report is invented when no correction was required.

initial.reportKind: Fresh independent, blind, read-only complete-task Japanese content review

reviewer.identityLimit: No exact model identity/version was exposed to this reviewer.

provenance.snapshotQualification: Reviewed the supplied frozen bytes, including the two pilot records. The version and baseline match the requested snapshot metadata. This does not independently recompute a repository-wide manifest version or certify the live working tree.
blindness: Did not inspect live counter drafts, author-c4.py, authoring-scope notes, docs\counter-n3-c4.json, other batch ledgers/reviews, session history, author scores/rationale or other agents.
Read the public repository instructions and only the relevant Numbers & counters format/answer-policy sections.
Used contract source metadata as navigation, not as evidence that its conclusions were correct.
Reused only the expressly permitted four dictionary-entry artifacts and two vocabulary PDFs; accessed the isolated pdf-tools package only to parse those PDFs.
Did not inspect application source, run product builds/tests, operate a device, publish, commit or change authentication.

integrityVerification.fileMethod: SHA-256 and byte length of actual frozen file bytes, compared with every snapshot.json entry. No newline normalization was needed or substituted.
integrityVerification.recordMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')), compared with every review-contract.json items[].runtimeRecordSha256; record ID and owning path also checked.
integrityVerification.interpretation: Hash agreement establishes which bytes were reviewed, not Japanese correctness.

article.description: Only Identifiers, ranks and text quantities and its new JMdict/Sanabo references received a new article review. The complete article file was hashed; that does not expand the linguistic review to its other sections.

completeTaskChecklist: Question-side operation and conditions in each applicable mode
Japanese construction, cue/translation and counted noun where present
Every vocabulary occurrence, reading and gloss
Every good, kana, writtenAnswers and readingAnswers member
Every authored distractor and complete resulting construction
File-level unit, base reading, title, group, level qualification and applicable source links

overall.meaningOfClean: No actionable defect or consequential unresolved live linguistic claim was established in the assigned snapshot and scope. This is not exhaustive certification of all possible dialectal, historical, specialist or infrequent variants.
overall.summary: All 29 complete records were independently reviewed. The specified readings and accepted alternatives fit the actual constructions. The article appropriately separates labels, quantities, ranks, digit positions and text units. Coverage is of these scaffolded tasks, not independent counter selection, general mastery, empirical difficulty or official JLPT membership.

runtimeReconciliation.basis: Supplied review-contract.json runtime plus the public counter format contract; no application inspection or device inference.
runtimeReconciliation.schema1ChooseType: The Japanese sentence and inline vocabulary are the question. Its English translation and note are answer-side. The section task remains answerable without those answer-side fields: the three headings visibly name the sections.
runtimeReconciliation.schema1Read: The displayed canonical 三節 is read さんせつ. Accepted alternate counting expressions in good/kana are not readings of 三節.
runtimeReconciliation.schema2Write: Every expression requests a specified notation/unit and a whole expression. The accepted kanji and Arabic numeral spellings preserve the same requested quantity/identifier. Bare units and semantic substitutes are not required answers to these fixed-notation tasks.
runtimeReconciliation.schema2Read: The displayed canonical expression is the reading target, with its visible cue supplying the sense. A counter named in a Write cue is not evidence of free selection in Read. The new script instructions say 'For writing'; they do not require kanji or Arabic numerals as the reading answer. The two pilot cues have no conflicting numeral-script restriction.
runtimeReconciliation.normalization: Did not demand full-width/whitespace aliases already handled by NFKC/whitespace normalization, or katakana duplicates handled by reading normalization. Did not assume v2 numeral arithmetic or automatic counter substitution. In v1, normalized good is checked first: bare セクション/せくしょん overlap must not be misreported as a missing answer or guaranteed Hard.

labelIndex.scope: Read the complete supplied source-wide mapping. Compared every scoped file's counter/base reading and the v1 distractor labels with that mapping.
labelIndex.sharedLabel: Both section files use 節/せつ. Base readings do not erase contextual surface changes such as 一巻/いっかん or 一課/いっか. 棟's base label does not make every other documented reading of 棟 wrong.

rubric.scale: Each axis 0-2, using the supplied rubric. Feedback is positive explanatory value, not difficulty.
interpretation: Vectors describe the complete authored task, with mode differences noted. They are not empirical learner measurements.
An isolated supplied unit/short label normally has lexicalLoad 0. The supported report sentence has modest additional Japanese vocabulary; the explicit 以内 operator receives lexicalLoad 1.

A specified unit is not independent counter selection. decisionLoad 1 is used only where a competing identifier and quantity require choosing the relevant number; reading the displayed result does not itself make that decision.
Every calculation score is 0: the tasks provide quantities or require notation/interpretation, not an arithmetic operation. Recognizing that only one lesson was completed is not an arithmetic step.
Routine kanji/Arabic spellings leave a narrow answer space. answerAmbiguity 1 marks handled substantive alternatives: the v1 alternative units and 八巻's two readings.
Feedback 2 is justified here by the explicit decisive contrasts, not assigned because the records carry level 3.

files.evidence: Count/label contrasts are contextual, not mandatory 第 or exclusive 冊/巻 rules. 課 contractions, 巻 variants, 位/級/段, 桁, 行 and character-limit readings agree with the inspected evidence. Grade systems, leading zero, inclusive maximum and aircraft/service distinctions are sufficiently qualified. The せつ/ふし comparison does not claim that every other sense of せつ is impossible.

All four records, including both preserved pilots, reviewed afresh. Specified 第/課 labels and completed-lesson counts are distinguished; いっか and ろっか are supported. No pilot acceptance was used as evidence.
Third-chapter label and count of three chapters are separate requests; no universal necessity for 第 is asserted.

Entire sentence, noun, six vocabulary entries and their occurrences, 8 good members, 7 kana members, canonical reading, three distractors and note inspected. This is strongly cued section recognition/completion, not unaided transfer.
Supplied 節 notation with さんせつ matches the report's section-count sense; it shares a context with the v1 task.
Both full 第 label and contextual short menu label are valid; neither asserts watched-episode totals.
Both 八巻 readings are supported. Repeated physical copies retain the same volume identifier; the paired 冊 task is not an additional independent situation.
三冊 correctly counts three physical books; the explanation explicitly avoids a universal 巻/冊 exclusivity rule.
いちい and さんい fit race placings. Tree, court-rank and approximation senses do not dictate readings for this scenario.
いっきゅう/にきゅう are appropriate numerical grade labels, with no universal scale or modern JLPT equivalence asserted.
One physical tier and third tier from the top are clear. The latter explicitly excludes the direction phrase from the submitted expression.
ひとけた/ふたけた apply to explicitly printed digits. The 07 task forbids first normalizing the label to numerical seven.
いちぎょう/ろくぎょう are supported line counts. Separate いっこう and bank-counter こう are not accepted as readings of these text quantities.
Two written kanji are not morae or words; ふたもじ is directly supported. Twenty-character maximum uses explicitly supplied 文字以内.
五十字以内 is a correct inclusive character limit. 字 is requested notation, not a ban on 文字 in ordinary character limits.
Flight 3 and two scheduled departures are separately specified. Single-digit readings do not claim multi-digit airline or radio-call conventions.
